degree.text: Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering.

description.text: Teaching Objective After the course you will be expertise in electrified transmission and power system operation, automatic control, power electronics, information processing, experimental analysis, product development, technological management, the use of professional software and some electrical engineering related areas. Main Courses Advanced Mathematics, Elementary Chinese, Intermediate Chinese, College Physics, Circuit Analysis, Foundation of Electrical Machinery & Towage, Analog Electronic Technology, Digital Electronic Technology, Principle of Automatic Control, Electrical Power Engineering, Principle of , Power Electronics, Electrical Power Towage Automatic Control System. Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering. Future Career Graduates can be comprehensive talents to make research in the electrical field, maintain and control system in the enterprise, develop new device in the electrical institute or make teaching in the university.

duration.text: The Electrical Engineering at Bohai University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1805 USD/per year ￥ 13000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport 1). The first page of the passport (Indentity Page).With photo, passport number &expiration date and full name. 2). Two blank pages of the passport. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5. Sponsorship Certificate

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. High school graduate or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate 3. Be in good health condition and above the age of 18 4. Observe the law and regulations of People's Republic of China and all regulations of the university
